Titans RB Tyjae Spears (knee), WR Carnell Tate (shoulder) and P Tommy Townsend (knee) did not practice Friday and are doubtful (NFL.com, Fri Oct 30).

column5: Monday night game. Seahawks LT Charles Cross has a high ankle sprain and could miss 1-2 weeks; WR Rashid Shaheed's knee news was positive (NFL.com, Mon Oct 26). Bears RB Kyle Monangai (toe) is on the injury list (Yahoo Sports, Mon Oct 26). The Seahawks agreed to acquire G Quenton Nelson from the Colts (ESPN, Tue Oct 27, 11:39 AM CT). Seahawks RB Zach Charbonnet (knee) could return this week and RB Jadarian Price (chest) is expected to practice (Forbes, Wed Oct 28). Bears RB Kyle Monangai (toe) remains out; he has missed three straight games (Yahoo Sports, Tue Oct 27, 2:25 PM CT). The Bears acquired DT Jeffery Simmons from the Titans for 2027 and 2028 first-round picks and a 2027 fourth-round pick, per ESPN's Adam Schefter; he is expected to debut Monday (RotoWire, Thu Oct 29). Seahawks RB Zach Charbonnet (knee) practiced in full Thursday, his fourth straight full session; RB Jadarian Price (chest), designated to return from IR, was limited (CBS Sports, Thu Oct 29, 6:06 PM CT; NBC Sports, Thu Oct 29, 6:12 PM CT). Bears RB Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) missed practice again Friday; TE Colston Loveland (neck) was added to the report after a limited practice and LB D'Marco Jackson (ankle) did not practice. Final designations come after Saturday's practice (Shaw Local, Fri Oct 30, 3:36 PM CT).
